Family trip · Oct 23–27

Friday, October 23

Straight into the fire 🔥
  1. ~10:30 AM

    Airport pickup → straight to Universal, no detours.

  2. Universal Studios Florida · 9 AM–5 PM

    Closes early for Halloween Horror Nights. The plan: E.T. Adventure, DreamWorks Land (Trollercoaster ✅ at 40″, Po's Kung Fu Training Camp play area), Despicable Me Minion Mayhem (40″ ✅).

    At 40″ William clears every minimum here, but he'll need a supervising companion (14+) on the rides.

  3. ~5 PM · Islands of Adventure · open till 8 PM

    Seuss Landing (Cat in the Hat 36″+ ✅, One Fish Two Fish + Caro-Seuss-el any-height), Camp Jurassic playground, Pteranodon Flyers (36″+, rides with an adult ✅ — note adults can only ride it as his escort).

  4. Evening

    CityWalk dinner if anyone's still standing, then home.

Heads-up Jurassic Park River Adventure, the Horror Make-Up Show and Finnegan's are all closed this month — don't plan around them.
Reality check Landing at 10 AM → parks till 8 PM is a marathon, especially for William. Stroller nap, zero guilt about tapping out early.
Have fun 🎢
